description: This file defines an abstract base class 'WebsocketService' for managing websocket connections with features like automatic reconnection, error handling, and message processing. It includes methods for connection verification, reconnection logic with exponential backoff, message sending with retries, and a receive loop with error handling.

classes.name: WebsocketService
classes.description: An abstract base class providing websocket connection management with automatic reconnection, error handling, and message processing logic. Subclasses implement specific connection and message handling methods.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the WebsocketService with optional automatic reconnection on error.

methods.name: _verify_connection
methods.description: Checks if the websocket connection is active and responsive by sending a ping.

methods.name: _reconnect_websocket
methods.description: Attempts to reconnect the websocket and verify the connection.

methods.name: _try_reconnect
methods.description: Retries reconnection with exponential backoff up to a maximum number of retries, reporting errors if provided.

methods.name: send_with_retry
methods.description: Sends a message over websocket, attempting to reconnect and retry if sending fails.

methods.name: _receive_task_handler
methods.description: Continuously receives messages, handling errors and attempting reconnection on failures.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Abstract method for establishing a connection, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: _disconnect
methods.description: Abstract method for disconnecting, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: _connect_websocket
methods.description: Abstract method for establishing websocket connection, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: _disconnect_websocket
methods.description: Abstract method for closing websocket connection, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: _receive_messages
methods.description: Abstract method for receiving and processing messages, to be implemented by subclasses.
